text: Have you experienced any abdominal pain, changes in bowel habits, or noticed any blood in your stool? I would also like to examine your abdomen for any masses or tenderness.

text: Do you have any history of diabetes, and have you noticed any swelling in your legs or shortness of breath? I will now examine your abdomen for any masses or hepatosplenomegaly.
